_doc: Per letter id (order P, I…VIII, E): words = 8 lemma keys for the "today's words" card, chosen from that letter by chapter band (P/I–II: A1–A2, III–V: B1, VI–VIII/E: B2–C1; widened by one band only when needed), never repeating a lemma of an earlier letter; no names, function words, single letters or words spelled exactly like their English gloss. spots = [{i: plate spot index, w: lemma key, was: old spot word}] — a replacement only for weak spot words (names, pronouns, verb forms, cognates, letters); the lemma occurs in the quoted message and names something in the picture; [] when none is needed or none fits. phrases = 1–2 expressions copied verbatim from the letter: {t: text, m: message index, ko, en, note_ko, note_en}.

phrases.en: a few little fields and a good life
phrases.note_ko: 고야가 평생 되풀이한 꿈. -ico 는 아라곤 말투의 ‘작은’ 꼴이에요.
phrases.note_en: Goya's lifelong dream; -ico is the Aragonese ‘little’ ending.

phrases.note_ko: parecer + que: 보이는 대로 짐작할 때.
phrases.note_en: parecer + que: to say how things look.

phrases.note_ko: mi 는 ‘나의’. 고야는 편지에서 아내를 늘 이렇게 불러요.
phrases.note_en: mi = my; Goya always calls her this in his letters.

phrases.note_ko: alegrarse: ‘기뻐하다’. Me alegro que … 로 기쁜 까닭을 말해요.
phrases.note_en: alegrarse: to be glad; Me alegro (de) que … gives the reason.

phrases.note_ko: dar gracias: ‘고맙다고 하다’. 그냥 Gracias 라고도 해요.
phrases.note_en: dar gracias: to give thanks; plain Gracias also works.

phrases.note_ko: 아주 큰 고마움. 오늘은 Muchas gracias 를 더 많이 써요.
phrases.note_en: Very warm thanks; today Muchas gracias is more common.
estar bueno: to be well (in health); ya = now, already.
A formal opening for an official note.

phrases.note_ko: 옛 편지의 맺음말. 오늘날 Atentamente 와 비슷해요.
phrases.note_en: An old letter closing, like today's Atentamente.
A letter opening; to a woman, Querida.
To wrap up and move on.

phrases.note_ko: por la gracia de Dios: 고마운 일을 말할 때.
phrases.note_en: por la gracia de Dios: for a blessing.

phrases.note_ko: no + 동사: 부정. necesitar de 는 옛 말투예요.
phrases.note_en: no + verb makes it negative; necesitar de is old usage.

phrases.en: is ever so grateful to you
phrases.note_en: estimar: to value, to be grateful for.

phrases.note_ko: hacer 의 접속법. 부탁 · 바람에 써요.
phrases.note_en: Subjunctive of hacer, for requests and wishes.
